svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Serverless document pipeline on IBM Cloud Code Engine subtitle: Each upload to Object Storage starts a Code Engine job run that writes to PostgreSQL, and an app serves the results direction: right # The tightest spacing keeps the five columns inside a README column at full label size. layout: { spacing: 0.5 } # IBM's technical diagram guide asks for a legend in every diagram, so solid lines get one too. legend: solid: Requests and data access dashed: Events and notifications dotted: Container images groups: # orrery has no IBM group styles; IBM's guide draws groups as plain outlined boxes, so these use # the neutral types with Carbon icons in the headers, as in ibm-cloud-openshift. ibmcloud: { type: box, label: IBM Cloud, icon: ibm:ibm-cloud } # A Code Engine project is the boundary: its apps, jobs and event subscriptions share one # namespace, scale to zero and are billed only while they run. project: { type: box, label: Code Engine project, icon: ibm:ibm-cloud-code-engine, in: ibmcloud } nodes: partners: { icon: ibm:document-import, label: Partner systems, note: S3 API uploads } staff: { icon: ibm:user-multiple, label: Operations team, note: Browser } registry: { icon: ibm:container-registry, label: Container Registry, note: Private images, in: ibmcloud } cos: { icon: ibm:object-storage, label: Cloud Object Storage, note: Inbound bucket, in: ibmcloud } job: { icon: ibm:job-run, label: Extract job, note: "Code Engine job, one run per object", in: project } app: { icon: ibm:application-web, label: Review app, note: "Code Engine app, scales to zero", in: project } db: { icon: ibm:ibm-cloud-databases, label: Databases for PostgreSQL, note: Extracted records, in: ibmcloud } en: { icon: ibm:ibm-cloud-event-notification, label: Event Notifications, note: Pipeline topic, in: ibmcloud } email: { icon: ibm:email, label: Email, note: Destination } slack: { icon: logos:slack-icon, label: Slack, note: Destination } edges: - partners -> cos: PUT # A COS event subscription in the project turns each object write into a job run. - cos --> job: write event - job -> db: insert - staff -> app: HTTPS - app -> db: query - job --> en: run finished - en --> email, slack - registry ..> project: pull

svg.title: Serverless document pipeline on IBM Cloud Code Engine
svg.desc: Serverless document pipeline on IBM Cloud Code Engine. 10 components in 2 groups. Connections: Partner systems to Cloud Object Storage (PUT); Cloud Object Storage to Extract job (write event); Extract job to Databases for PostgreSQL (insert); Operations team to Review app (HTTPS); Review app to Databases for PostgreSQL (query); Extract job to Event Notifications (run finished); Event Notifications to Email; Event Notifications to Slack; Container Registry to Code Engine project (pull).

text.tspan: SERVERLESS DOCUMENT PIPELINE ON IBM CLOUD CODE ENGINE
Each upload to Object Storage starts a Code Engine job run that writes to PostgreSQL, and an app serves the results
